proof_summary: For \(n=162178349052694\), the integer \(1813934020268071832273=a(n)+4\) lies strictly between the two proposed endpoints. A covering system modulo \(96\) shows that for every positive exponent, its product with the corresponding power of \(2\), plus \(1\), is divisible by one of \(3,5,17,257,65537,97,673,193\), so this intervening odd integer is itself a Sierpiński number.
